requiredAccounts.description: The wallet that signs and sends the deployment transaction. Must hold Sepolia ETH for gas.

steps.action: Deploy the compiled NumberRegistry artifact to Ethereum Sepolia with no constructor arguments.
Record the verified deployment address and transaction hash.
Verify the contract on Etherscan or a compatible block explorer.

Run post-deployment checks: get for unknown address returns false and zero, set emits NumberSet, overwrite keeps count unchanged, clear emits NumberCleared, clear without entry reverts NoEntry, and count reflects active entries.
